name: WorkAxle
tagline: Time clock, schedules, tasks and team chat for an enterprise workforce platform
role: Mobile app development for a workforce-management platform

scenes.title: Time clock, breaks and a shift log
scenes.body: Clock-in waits for location and Bluetooth checks; paid breaks, a task tracker and a filterable shift log.

scenes.title: Schedules with shift swaps built in
scenes.body: Personal and department views; trade a shift, find cover or request time off right from the schedule.

scenes.title: Availability set by the employee
scenes.body: Weekly hour and shift limits, repeating weekdays and a night-shift opt-in, saved as scheduling preferences.

scenes.title: Department group chats
scenes.body: Team messaging with photo sharing, read receipts and join or leave notices.

scenes.title: The client's platform
scenes.body: The employee app is the frontline end of WorkAxle's scheduling and compliance platform for multi-site teams.
